---
applyTo: "**/*.json,**/*.jsonc"
---
Before you change a file these instructions apply to, read `.kit/rules/json.md` and follow it. The kit places it
there and keeps it current, so it is read, never edited. A file this rule governs by its content rather than its name,
such as a script with no suffix, is named by `kit context <path>`. How the kit works is in `.kit/1st.md`.
